WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) as customer_total
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY CustomerId
),
total_revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(customer_total) as overall_total
  FROM customer_totals
),
customer_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ct.customer_total,
    ct.customer_total / tr.overall_total as share
  FROM customer_totals ct
  CROSS JOIN total_revenue tr
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM customer_shares
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.customer_total,
    cs.share,
    (cs.share - av.avg_share) / av.avg_share as relative_difference
  FROM customer_shares cs
  CROSS JOIN average_share av
  WHERE cs.share > av.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  AVG(customer_total) as avg_total_spent,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(relative_difference) as avg_relative_difference
FROM above_average
